text:
Diego Morales: Hi all, first day here! Quick onboarding/security Q: my laptop arrived but the enrollment assistant errored with 'attestation failed'. FileVault is on but SSO login keeps redirecting to an internal error. Also I saw a phishing sim scheduled for my email cohort 10. Can I opt out of using a personal phone for Duo? Who do I ping for attestation issues?

Anya Feldman: welcome Diego :wave: Ping #it-triage or @IT Triage for attestation. For Duo personal-phone opt-out you'll need manager approval + security review; we can issue a YubiKey instead. Phishing sims are cohort-based; you won't be singled out.

IT Triage: Diego, please paste the exact attestation error and the output of `spctl --status` and `profiles status -type enrollment`. Common cause: TPM/secure enclave mismatch or network blocking the attestation server. If you prefer, we can escalate and remote in.

Diego Morales: spctl says "assessments enabled". profiles output: "Enrolled
Compliance: noncompliant
Attestation: failed (400)". Attestation error shows: "client_cert: not trusted".

Anya Feldman: That looks like a cert chain problem from the device image. IT can re-provision or push the CA cert. @Priya Kapoor if we push a CA, any compliance notes for the asset record?

Priya Kapoor: If IT pushes a CA cert we note it in the asset record and require a follow-up integrity check. For Duo opt-out: manager approval + create a security ticket with justification; Security will either approve YubiKey or temporary OTP tokens. For phishing sims: if you fail, you get instant feedback + a 5-10 min micro-training; no punitive action for first offense.

IT Triage: We'll try a quick remediation: (1) push intermediate CA, (2) re-run attestation. Diego, can you join a 15-min remote now? If yes, reply with your timezone.

Diego Morales: I'm PT, free now for 15. Also small thing: the onboarding email asked to confirm my manager for training portal 1, should that be my hiring manager or team lead?

Priya Kapoor: Put your hiring manager (Lara Shin) as primary for training approvals; add your team lead as secondary if you want faster sign-offs. Training assigned when asset records are compliant.

onboarding-bot: Security training queued: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Diego Morales. Tentative due date: 2025-09-18 (subject to compliance). Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Diego Morales: Thanks team, joining the remote session now. Appreciate the quick help :)
